verdict.rationale: Orb's docs state that official SDKs are available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, and Ruby. The documented API those SDKs wrap supports idempotency, cursor pagination and typed error responses, which suits programmatic, agent-driven integration. The SDK evidence is a single one-line claim, though. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK documentation (installation, typing, versioning, generation source), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, and a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (the probe found all candidate paths returned 404).
